name: Sara Timberlain
summary: Sara Timberlain is a skilled tailor residing at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. Known for her resourceful needlework with salvaged fabrics, she assists the war effort by stitching cloth and leather armaments for the Stormwind Army.

sections.title: Needlework on the Frontier
sections.body: Situated outside a small cottage on the western edge of the Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain works tirelessly with needle and thread amidst the ambient noise of felling axes. Despite the remote nature of Eastvale and the looming threat of prowling wolves and murlocs, she provides hospitality and vital craftwork to travelers. Her talent for turning scraps of linen and salvaged bandanas into durable gear has earned her official recognition, securing commissions to supply protective cloth and leather armaments directly to Stormwind's military forces.

faq.answer: Sara Timberlain is an accomplished seamstress living at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. She is renowned for crafting practical gear from reclaimed fabrics and holds contracts to supply the Stormwind Army.

faq.q: Where can I find Sara Timberlain?
faq.answer: She can be found sitting outside a house on the western side of the Eastvale Logging Camp, situated in the far eastern reaches of Elwynn Forest along the road to Redridge.

faq.q: Why is Sara gathering cloth for the army?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army relies on local crafters to maintain their equipment stockpiles. Sara uses salvaged cloth, such as linen collected by adventurers, to fashion sturdy garments and armor linings for the kingdom's soldiers.

angles.text: Sara exemplifies the resourcefulness of frontier tailors, turning scraps of rough linen and bandit cloth into functional garments commissioned by the military.
Outlying settlements like Eastvale directly sustain the kingdom's defense, with local craftspeople supplying basic armor to the under-resourced Stormwind Army.
